scope: Private compiler algorithm experiment; first-occurrence queue filtering only

patches.name: first-occurrence-roots-and-enqueue

sourceArgument: file_book clears SRCS before roots; duplicate queued keys are skipped by SRCS.has before memo_gc/lookup/types/body. Filtering roots and all three append sites preserves first unique encounter order and unique-definition effects. type_adts call sites and arguments remain evaluated unchanged; refs/fl.sites/term_any remain unchanged.
boundaries: Potential queue memory/iteration contribution only. No type_adts traversal reduction, emitter rewrite, universal proof, or speed/bottleneck claim. Existing context now records deduplicated queue lengths. At successful file_book exit queueLength equals uniqueVisited; partial cutoff can include unvisited pending keys.
